雅思周末复习 · 第 3 周（11 月 7 日 周六）

这周五天（11 月 2 日到 6 日）的内容都在这一页里，大概 60 分钟。建议顺序：单词 15 分钟，听写 10 分钟，听力表达 5 分钟，阅读 15 分钟，写作口语 15 分钟。不用联网，手机上也能用。

1. 单词自测（15 分钟）

本周主词表 121 个，按天分组（有 4 个词几天都出现过，只放在第一次出现那天）。点卡片任意位置播放英音，点中文可以单独显示或隐藏。中文默认是隐藏的（显示“点击显示”），先看英文说意思，说不出来再点开。每天下面还有听前难词（共 38 个，跟主词表重复的已经去掉），有时间再刷。

3. 听力表达回顾（5 分钟）

五集 BBC 6 Minute English，共 22 个重点表达。中文默认隐藏，先自己想意思再点开。斜体是节目原文里主持人解释这个表达的那句话。

完整音频和原文都在每天的早间页面里（11-02 到 11-06 早间），这里为了文件小没有再放进来。哪集表达忘得多，就回那天页面再听一遍。

周一 11月2日：Who does the housework?（谁来做家务？）

  • fair share 应分担的那份点击显示
    Pippa: If you do your fair share of work, you do a reasonable amount.
  • women's work 女人的活（贬义）点击显示
    Neil: Women's work is a negative term for the boring and repetitive tasks which are stereotypically done by women.
  • division of labour 劳动分工点击显示
    Pippa: The division of labour is a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people.
  • take a breather 喘口气，歇一会儿点击显示
    Neil: The idiom take a breather means to stop what you're doing for a short time and rest.
  • pull your weight 尽到自己那份力点击显示
    Neil: If you pull your weight, you work as hard as everyone else.

周二 11月3日：How do we describe smells?（我们怎么描述气味？）

  • shut something down 打断，让某事停下来点击显示
    Neil: The phrase to shut something down means to stop it.
  • stinky / fragrant 臭的 / 芳香的点击显示
    Neil: The adjective stinky means foul smelling, while the adjective fragrant means pleasant smelling.
  • visual / auditory / olfactory 视觉的 / 听觉的 / 嗅觉的点击显示
    Georgie: The adjective visual means related to seeing, and auditory means related to hearing. The adjective for things related to smelling is olfactory.
  • petrichor 雨后泥土的气味点击显示
    Georgie: It's called petrichor. It's that smell of the ground just after it's rained.

周三 11月4日：Sharing the road with driverless cars（和无人驾驶汽车共用马路）

  • eye contact 眼神交流点击显示
    Phil: Usually, a driver makes eye contact with me. They look directly into my eyes and then wave me across.
  • wave 挥手点击显示
    Phil: To wave means to raise your hand and move it from side to side.
  • alert 提醒，警告点击显示
    Pippa: To alert somebody means to warn them about a potential danger.
  • glance 一瞥，扫一眼点击显示
    Phil: A glance at something means a quick look.
  • jaywalking 乱穿马路点击显示
    Pippa: And finally, the American English term jaywalking means crossing the road where you're not supposed to.

周四 11月5日：Rude emails（粗鲁的邮件）

  • put someone on the defensive 让人产生戒备点击显示
    Becca: The phrase to put someone on the defensive means to do or say something which makes them feel threatened or unsure.
  • uncivil / incivility 无礼的 / 无礼行为点击显示
    Phil: The adjective uncivil means impolite, and we have a similar noun that's incivility.
  • belittle 贬低点击显示
    Becca: To belittle someone means to make them feel inferior or unimportant.
  • get something off your plate 把事情甩出去点击显示
    Becca: To get something off your plate means to give someone else a task or problem instead of dealing with it yourself.

周五 11月6日：The Enhanced Games（增强运动会）

  • performance-enhancing drugs 提高成绩的药物点击显示
    Neil: Cheating in sport through the use of performance-enhancing drugs, informally called doping, is normally considered wrong.
  • divisive 引起分裂／分歧的点击显示
    Pippa: Dan also describes the games as divisive – an adjective that means causing a lot of disagreement between people.
  • cross the line 越界，做出不可接受的事点击显示
    Neil: The phrase to cross the line means to start behaving in a way that's not socially acceptable.
  • normalise 使正常化点击显示
    Pippa: And finally, to normalise something means to treat it as normal or acceptable when previously it wasn't.

4. 阅读易错题回顾（15 分钟）

从这周五篇 G 类阅读里挑出最容易错的题，主要是 NOT GIVEN、标题干扰项、信息匹配重复选项和填空单复数。先看原文片段，自己判断，再点开答案。虚线词点一下显示中文。

判断题口诀：原文说反了是 FALSE，原文没说是 NOT GIVEN。填空题记得核对单复数和字数要求，匹配题注意选项可以重复用。

周一 Section 3：The Surprising Story of the Pencil（标题匹配 + 句子结尾 + 简答）

…the mine became one of the most closely guarded places… deliberately flooded… a law that made stealing graphite a serious crime…

Q2. Paragraph B 选哪个标题？（ii Strict measures to protect a valuable resource／vii The environmental cost of making pencils）

点开看答案

ii　strict measures = 看守、灌水、搜身、立法；valuable resource 对应 value of the deposit。

It might be expected that the computer would have made the pencil obsolete, yet billions are still manufactured…

Q6. Paragraph F 选哪个标题？（vi Why an old tool still has a place／ix The decline of handwriting in schools）

点开看答案

vi　still has a place = 电脑时代还在大量生产。ix 是干扰项，原文提孩子学写字，但没说书写在学校衰落。

…between these periods it was deliberately flooded so that thieves could not get in.

Q8. The Borrowdale mine was regularly flooded ______（A to stop thieves from entering when work had stopped.／F in order to make cannonballs lighter.）

点开看答案

A　when work had stopped = between these periods（不开放的时候），选 A。F 说炮弹变轻，原文没说。

…wrapping sticks of it in string or sheepskin.

Q11. Apart from string, what did early users wrap graphite in?（NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS）

点开看答案

sheepskin　题目说 apart from string，所以答 sheepskin。

The German city of Nuremberg became a centre of production…

Q14. Which German city became a centre of pencil production?（NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS）

点开看答案

nuremberg　centre of pencil production = centre of production，答 Nuremberg，首字母大小写都算对。

周二 Section 1：五家搬家公司广告 + Riverside 诊所预约新规

Customers must be over 25…

Q3. Customers have to be above a certain age.（A Swift Move　B Careful Carriers　C Budget Vans　D Global Relocations　E Student Shift）

点开看答案

C　above a certain age = over 25。

Moves are available in the evenings and at weekends only…

Q5. This company only works outside normal office hours.（A Swift Move　B Careful Carriers　C Budget Vans　D Global Relocations　E Student Shift）

点开看答案

E　outside normal office hours = evenings and weekends only，关键是 only。

…can usually offer a booking within 48 hours.

Q7. This company can often move people at very short notice.（A Swift Move　B Careful Carriers　C Budget Vans　D Global Relocations　E Student Shift）

点开看答案

A　at very short notice = within 48 hours。B 要提前三周，正好相反。

A nurse will call you back within two hours…

Q10. For same-day appointments, a ______ will phone the patient back.（ONE WORD）

点开看答案

nurse　phone back = call back，打回来的是 nurse 不是 doctor，这是常见陷阱。

…please cancel at least 24 hours beforehand…

Q14. Cancel at least ______ hours before the appointment.（ONE WORD/NUMBER）

点开看答案

24　beforehand = before the appointment，填 24。别被 200 和 three 干扰。

周三 Section 2：Greenway 超市新员工须知 + 培训／Team Leader（TFNG + 句子填空）

If any item … is damaged while you are at work, it will be replaced at no cost to you.

Q2. Staff must pay for a uniform item that gets damaged at work.

点开看答案

FALSE　at no cost = 免费，和“必须付钱”相反，FALSE。要付 12 英镑的是丢失的衣服，别看串。

You will need to provide your own plain black trousers…

Q3. Staff have to buy their black trousers from a particular shop.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　原文只说自备黑裤子，完全没提必须去哪家店买，NOT GIVEN。

The staff room … has lockers, a fridge and a water dispenser.

Q5. Staff can heat up their own food in the staff room.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　只列了储物柜、冰箱、饮水机，没说能不能热饭，NOT GIVEN。别用常识脑补微波炉。

…a 20% discount on most products, although alcohol and gift cards are excluded.

Q6. The staff discount can be used on every product in the store.

点开看答案

FALSE　most 不等于 every，还有排除项，FALSE。

…every application must include a recommendation from your store manager.

Q10. An application for the Team Leader Programme must contain a ______ from the store manager.（NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS）

点开看答案

recommendation　contain = include，填 recommendation。

周四 Section 3：Keeping Things Cool（信息匹配 + YES/NO/NG + 选项框摘要）

…a mild winter meant that lakes did not freeze thickly enough, which led to shortages and sharp rises in price.

Q2. an explanation of how the weather could affect the cost of a product

点开看答案

C　weather 对应 mild winter，cost of a product 对应 rises in price。

Fridges using CFCs were considered completely safe… Decades later… CFCs were damaging the ozone layer…

Q5. an example of a solution that later caused an unexpected problem

点开看答案

E　solution = 用 CFC 取代有毒气体，unexpected problem = 后来发现破坏臭氧层。

These warnings were not without foundation, since several outbreaks of illness were later linked to dirty ice.

Q8. Concerns about the cleanliness of natural ice were justified.

点开看答案

YES　not without foundation 双重否定 = 有根据 = justified，所以 YES。别看到 not 就选 NO。

He went on to build one of the first practical ice-making machines, which was quickly bought by breweries…

Q9. Harrison made a large fortune from his ice-making machine.

点开看答案

NOT GIVEN　原文只说机器卖给啤酒厂，完全没提他赚没赚大钱，所以 NOT GIVEN。别用常识脑补。

Some critics argue that we have lost our connection with the seasons… To the writer, this seems a small price to pay…

Q10. Losing touch with the seasons is a serious disadvantage of refrigeration.

点开看答案

NO　有人认为是缺点，但作者觉得代价很小，和“严重缺点”相反，所以 NO。YNNG 看的是作者观点，不是批评者观点。

In 1873 Harrison attempted to ship frozen meat to Britain, but the cooling system failed…

Q13. . In 1873 he tried to send ______ …（选项：A printer　B doctor　C breweries　D supermarkets　E frozen meat　F fresh fruit　G ship　H farmers）

点开看答案

E frozen meat　ended in failure = failed，选 E。F fresh fruit 原文没提。

周五 Section 1：五则短租广告 + Greenfield 回收通知

…done through our mobile app — there is no reception desk.

Q3. There is no staffed check-in desk.（A Harbour View Studio　B Maple Cottage　C City Loft　D Riverside Annex　E Quiet Corner）

点开看答案

C　no staffed check-in desk = no reception desk。

…designed for guests with limited mobility… wheelchair-accessible shower…

Q5. This place is suitable for people who use a wheelchair.（A Harbour View Studio　B Maple Cottage　C City Loft　D Riverside Annex　E Quiet Corner）

点开看答案

D　use a wheelchair 对应 wheelchair-accessible / limited mobility。

A free airport transfer can be arranged if you book at least 48 hours in advance.

Q7. An airport pickup can be provided if booked early enough.（A Harbour View Studio　B Maple Cottage　C City Loft　D Riverside Annex　E Quiet Corner）

点开看答案

D　airport pickup = airport transfer，booked early enough = at least 48 hours in advance。

Glass jars and metal cans must go in the grey box provided separately.

Q10. Glass jars and metal cans go in the ______ box.（ONE WORD；grey|gray）

点开看答案

grey　填 grey（美式 gray 也接受）。注意不是 blue bin。

…any waste left outside a bin will not be taken away.

Q13. Waste left beside a bin will ______ be taken away.（ONE WORD）

点开看答案

not　题目已有 be taken away，填 not。

5. 写作和口语回顾（15 分钟）

题目要点按周二、周四当天的写作任务整理，措辞可能跟当天页面上的原题略有不同，意思一样。先别看范文，花 3 分钟口头说一下你每段写什么，再点开对照。绿色高亮是可以直接背下来套用的句子。

周二书信题（正式）：给社区学院课程负责人写信询问课程

You are interested in an evening course at a local community college. Write a letter to the course coordinator. In your letter:

  • say which course you are interested in
  • ask for details about the schedule and fees
  • ask about any entry requirements

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter: Dear Mr Thompson,

点开看范文（正式语气，约 171 词）

Dear Mr Thompson,

I am writing to enquire about the evening courses in Business English that your college is offering this spring. I saw the advertisement on your website last week, and I would like to know a few more details before I apply.

First of all, could you please tell me how many hours of teaching there are each week, and whether the classes are held online or on campus? I work full time during the day, so I can only attend after 6 pm on weekdays. I would also be grateful if you could let me know the total fee for the course, and whether textbooks are included in that price.

Finally, I would like to ask about the entry requirements. I passed CET-4 several years ago, but I have not taken an English exam recently. Would it be possible for me to take a short placement test before the course starts?

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Wei

正式信：知道对方名字用 Dear Mr/Ms + 姓，结尾 Yours sincerely。不知道名字用 Dear Sir or Madam，结尾 Yours faithfully。询问细节用 Could you please… / I would be grateful if you could…

周四书信题（半正式）：给邻居写信为派对噪音道歉

You held a party at your flat last weekend and the noise disturbed your neighbour. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter:

  • apologise for the noise
  • explain what happened
  • say what you will do to make sure it does not happen again

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter: Dear Mrs Patel,

点开看范文（半正式语气，约 170 词）

Dear Mrs Patel,

I am writing to apologise for the noise from the party I held at my flat last Saturday evening. I know it went on later than I had planned, and that some of the music was far too loud.

I realise that you have young children who need to sleep, and that the noise must have been very disturbing, especially after 11 pm. There is no excuse for keeping neighbours awake, and I feel quite embarrassed about it.

To make sure this does not happen again, I will not host any parties on weeknights, and I will keep music at a reasonable volume and finish by 10 pm in future. If there is anything else I can do to make up for it, please let me know. I have also left a small box of chocolates outside your door as a small apology.

Once again, I am truly sorry for the inconvenience, and I hope we can continue to be good neighbours.

Kind regards,
Li Wei

半正式信：知道邻居姓氏，用 Dear Mrs/Mr + 姓，结尾 Kind regards 或 Best regards。道歉信三段通常是：道歉并说明情况 → 承认影响 → 补救措施和再次致歉。

周四大作文：孩子应该小学还是中学开始学外语

Some people think that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school, while others believe it is better to start at secondary school. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

点开看 7 分示范（约 223 词，四段式；当天进度是 intro + 两个 body 主题句 + 结论，这里补成完整范文）

Some people believe that children should begin learning a foreign language at primary school, while others think it is better to wait until secondary school. Although both views have merits, I believe that starting earlier brings more advantages overall.

On the one hand, introducing a foreign language in primary school can make learning feel natural. Young children pick up pronunciation and new sounds more easily, and they are usually less afraid of making mistakes. For example, a child who hears English songs and simple games every day may develop a good accent long before formal grammar is taught. Early exposure can also build confidence, so that by the time they reach secondary school they are ready for more difficult work.

On the other hand, some people argue that primary pupils already have a heavy timetable, and that a foreign language may take time away from reading and maths in their first language. Secondary students are also better at understanding grammar rules and can progress faster in a short time. However, these concerns can be managed if the primary course is short, playful and well designed, rather than another formal exam subject.

In conclusion, while secondary school offers clearer academic skills, I think children benefit more if they start a foreign language at primary level, because early practice builds pronunciation, confidence and long-term interest.

结构：第一段改写题目加立场，第二段小学开始的好处，第三段中学开始的理由并反驳，第四段总结。Discuss both views 题两边都要写到，最后立场要清楚。

周二大作文入门：居家办公利大于弊？

More and more people are working from home. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

当天只要求写开头段 + 一个主体段；下面给一篇短示范，方便你对照结构和套句。

点开看短示范（约 141 词）

Working from home has become much more common in recent years. In my view, the advantages of this arrangement clearly outweigh the disadvantages, especially for people with long commutes or caring responsibilities.

The main benefit is that employees save a great deal of time and money on travel. Instead of spending two hours on crowded trains, they can use that time to work, exercise or look after their family. Many people also find they can concentrate better at home without office interruptions. Of course, working from home can feel lonely, and some staff may mix work and rest badly. Even so, these problems can often be reduced by regular video meetings and clear working hours.

In conclusion, although home working is not perfect, its flexibility and efficiency make it a better option for many workers than a full-time office routine.

advantages outweigh 题：开头直接亮明利大于弊，主体段先写主要好处再让步提缺点，结尾重申立场。

口语 Part 1：本周六个话题

每个话题两道题，点开看 7 分示范答案。先自己大声说 30 秒左右，再看示范，挑一两个表达用到你自己的答案里。示范里的个人情况是通用写法，换成你自己的真实情况。

Handwriting（周一）

Do you often write by hand?

Not as much as I used to. Most of the time I type on my phone or laptop, because it's faster. But I still write shopping lists and short notes by hand, and when I'm studying English I prefer to write new words in a notebook. I find that helps me remember them better.

Do you think handwriting is still important?

Yes, I do. Even though we rely on keyboards, there are still forms to fill in, and exams like IELTS writing are done on paper in many test centres. Also, a handwritten card or letter feels more personal than a text message. So I don't think handwriting will disappear completely.

Public Transport（周一）

How often do you use public transport?

I use it almost every weekday. I take the train to work in the morning and come back the same way in the evening. At weekends I use it less, because I often stay near home, but if I'm meeting friends in the city centre I'll still take the subway rather than drive.

What do you dislike about public transport where you live?

The main problem is how crowded it gets in rush hour. Sometimes I can't even get a seat, and it's hard to read or reply to messages. Delays are annoying too, especially when a train is cancelled and everyone has to wait for the next one. Apart from that, the network itself is quite convenient.

Neighbours（周三）

Do you know your neighbours well?

I know the people next door reasonably well. We say hello when we see each other, and we've exchanged phone numbers in case of an emergency. We're not close friends, but we help each other with small things, like taking in a parcel. I think that's a good balance.

What kind of problems can people have with neighbours?

Noise is probably the most common one, especially if someone plays loud music late at night or has frequent parties. Parking spaces and shared rubbish areas can cause arguments too. Usually these things can be sorted out with a polite conversation, but if that fails people sometimes have to involve the building manager.

Mobile Phones（周三）

How often do you use your mobile phone?

To be honest, I use it far too much. I check messages first thing in the morning, and I probably pick it up dozens of times during the day for work emails, maps, or just scrolling the news. I've started leaving it in another room when I want to concentrate, because otherwise I get distracted.

What do you use your phone for most?

Apart from calls and messages, I mainly use it for language study apps, listening to podcasts on my commute, and mobile payments. I hardly ever carry cash now. I also take a lot of photos, especially when I travel. So it's basically my wallet, camera and study tool all in one.

Friends（周五）

How often do you see your friends?

During the week I don't see them that often, because everyone is busy with work. We usually meet up at the weekend, maybe once every two weeks, for dinner or a coffee. We also chat in a group message almost every day, so even when we can't meet we still keep in touch.

Do you prefer to have a few close friends or many friends?

I'd rather have a few close friends. I find it hard to maintain lots of shallow friendships, and I value people I can really talk to when something goes wrong. That said, I'm happy to be friendly with colleagues and classmates; I just don't call all of them close friends.

Films（周五）

What kinds of films do you like?

I mostly like dramas and the occasional comedy. I enjoy films with strong characters and a story that makes me think, rather than ones that are just special effects. Recently I've been watching some English-language films with subtitles, which is good practice for my listening as well as entertainment.

Do you prefer watching films at home or in the cinema?

Both have their advantages. At home I can pause whenever I want and it's much cheaper, so I watch most films on the sofa. But for a big new release, I still like going to the cinema. The big screen and the sound make it more exciting, and it feels like a proper night out.

6. 自查清单

  • 主词表遮住中文，至少能说出 102 个意思（大约 85%）。
  • 15 个听写词至少对 12 个，错的抄三遍。
  • 22 个听力表达能说出中文意思，并且至少能用 5 个各造一句。
  • 阅读易错题每道都能指出原文对应句，说清楚错在哪：没读全段、单复数、NOT GIVEN，还是干扰选项。
  • 能分清正式和半正式书信的开头结尾，两封范文的高亮句能默写一半以上。
  • 大作文能说出双方观点题的四段式结构，每段第一句写什么。
  • 六个口语话题每题都能连续说 20 到 30 秒，不卡壳。

写好的书信、大作文，或者口语录音转成的文字，直接发到聊天里，我帮你批改，告诉你大概几分、哪里可以改。
